name: Fillman & Sons Floors and More
hours: Mon to Fri 10 am to 4 pm. Closed Sat and Sun.
description: Fillman & Sons Floors and More is a family-owned flooring, remodeling, and decorating retailer in Emmaus, PA, with free estimates on carpet, hardwood, laminate, vinyl, tile, refinishing, countertops, window treatments, and custom bathrooms.

hero.headline: Floors, and the work around them
hero.sub: A family-owned flooring, remodeling, and decorating retailer in Emmaus, with a complete line of floors and free estimates.

offerings.heading: The complete <mark>line.</mark>
items: Carpet, ceramic, hardwood, laminate, and vinyl flooring
Hardwood refinishing that brings old floors back
Countertops, window treatments, painting and paper hanging, and full custom showers and bathrooms

story.heading: Floors and More means more
paragraphs: Fillman & Sons started with floors and grew into the rooms around them: countertops, window treatments, painting, paper hanging, and full bathroom remodels, all from the shop on Chestnut Street in Emmaus.
It is still a family business, which is why the estimate is free and the person who quotes the job is the person who answers the phone.

experience.heading: How a floor gets done
items: Call for a free estimate, then pick samples at the shop or at home.
Installation scheduled around the household, furniture moved and replaced.
Refinishing and repairs years later, from the same family.

feature.heading: Full custom showers and bathrooms
feature.text: Tile, glass, vanities, and floors come from one shop, so the bathroom is designed and installed as one job.
